Linear Programming Formulation of Max Flow:  Minimize $-x_{ts}$ subject to flow conservation constraints at each node and capacity constraints on each edge, where $x_{ts}$ represents the flow from source to sink through a fictitious arc with infinite capacity.<SLIDE 14><SLIDE 15>
Network Simplex Method: This algorithm solves network flow problems by iteratively improving a feasible solution on a spanning tree.  It involves three steps: (1) finding fair prices $y_i$ such that $y_i + c_{ij} = y_j$ for each arc $ij$ in the spanning tree; (2) identifying an arc $ij$ such that $y_i + c_{ij} < y_j$, indicating a potential improvement; and (3) adjusting shipments along the arcs to maintain feasibility while incorporating the identified arc. <SLIDE 4><SLIDE 5><SLIDE 6>
